messages.content: Please look up alice in the directory and check her availability for 2026-01-16. Then find meeting rooms for 6 attendees starting at 09:00 that day, shortlist the best option, prepare the reservation details, and book the room for 09:00–10:00 on 2026-01-16. After booking, get the room ticket and email it to alice with high priority. Also, please back up /projects/q1-planning as q1-planning-pre-meeting-backup, alert her about the backup by email, and send that notification directly to alice as well.
